summary: Combat Phase C — CANONICAL Ability Pipeline independently verified. Ran `python -m tactical.verify` (62 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 WARN, FOUNDATION STABLE: YES) and `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -q` (148 passed). Then authored a fresh 27-test independent behavioral suite (`test_ability_pipeline_t1_iter8.py`) exercising the pipeline from angles distinct from the developer's tests: preview contract fields, in-range/OOR/LOS/AP failure reasons, preview-vs-use_skill parity + AP economy (no consumption on illegal cast), data-driven cooldown ticking, zero-cooldown abilities not tracked, poison DoT + antidote cleanse, shielded halving+drop, war_cry embolden then expire, heal_zone zero tactical_value when nobody wounded, healing_totem heals wounded ally, raise_skeleton summon cap = 3, grease->oil_slick, pinning_shot roots + start-of-turn zeros movement + clears root, taunt sets target_id, AI role selection (Support heals wounded ally, Commander casts war_cry, cooldown skip returns None, in-range attacker picks damage ability), JSON export/import round-trip preserves statuses & cooldowns, every blueprint ability id resolves in the merged registry, and a summoner+support vs 2-hero party ability-rich battle resolves within a 40-round cap with no exceptions. Also asserts `actions.use_skill is abilities_engine.use_skill` (single canonical entry point, no duplicate combat path). Grand total 175 backend pytest tests passing (148 pre-existing + 27 new independent).
critical_code_review_comments: abilities_engine.py is a clean single source of truth: use_skill invokes ability_preview and returns False if not usable, guaranteeing preview-verdict parity and no AP consumption on illegal casts.
Cooldowns are fully data-driven (ab['cooldown'] field, unit.cooldowns dict, ticked in start_of_turn) — no per-ability hardcoding.
actions.use_skill is a direct alias to abilities_engine.use_skill (actions.py L22) — no duplicate combat path.
AI choose_ability reads the same ability_preview the player UI reads, satisfying the transparency pillar.

Minor: _tactical_value returns 0.0 for a summon whose effect is not heal_zone once summons_made>=3, but also 0.0 when unit.ai_memory has no 'summons_made' key ONLY if that expression short-circuits — verified fine (get(...,0) default).

Nit: ability_preview declares `expected_damage` only for attack/movement_attack/terrain-with-damage; control abilities like pinning_shot carry `damage: 4` but are typed 'control' so expected_damage is None. Consumers reading the preview should not rely on expected_damage for control effects — acceptable design choice, worth documenting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Ability pipeline is stable. When adding new abilities/enemies: (1) register ability id in abilities.json or ability_library.json with cooldown/ap/range/type/status/effect fields, (2) reference by id in enemies.json blueprint 'abilities' list — TestRegistryIntegrity will catch orphans, (3) if you add a new ability 'type', add a handler in _HANDLERS and a base value in _BASE_VALUE. FixedRNG pattern in the new test file is reusable for deterministic combat unit tests.
